component.name: Arbor
component.summary: See where your disk space grows

description.p: Arbor is a disk usage analyzer: it scans folders and shows where space goes, as a folder tree with sizes and as rings/treemap visualizations. Folders can be opened, their path copied, and items moved to the Trash with a mandatory confirmation and an undo.
First release: scanning, rings and treemap views, folder navigation, sorting, context-menu actions with mandatory trash confirmation and undo, keyboard and screen-reader support.
